text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: Option b samples 16.0 to 16.8 s. The tilted car floats across the brown channel inside a pale gray halo, with scalloped dot-foam at its upstream end and two thin curved pale strands trailing it. It passes beneath the fixed ledge slab and leaves frame left, half out at 16.6 s and two-thirds out at 16.8 s. Current stripes are thin; short stubs show near the right edge. The car stays above the caption. The nearest top crown is right of the chip; whether a crown edge sits under the chip at the extreme top-left corner is uncertain at this size.
